title: CampusGo / Supplier service
description: HTTP and logical database performance. Current values require fresh application telemetry.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"supplier-service"})) < bool 45) or on(service_name) ((label_replace(vector(0), "service_name", "supplier-service", "", "")) - 1)

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) or on(service_name) (0 * (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))))) / on(service_name) ((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) > 0)) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP p95 · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,le) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Estimated HTTP requests · selected range
panels.description: Extrapolated request count, not an audit total; fractional estimates and counter resets are expected.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Response-generation latency

See the rolling selected-range table for persistent request summaries.

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,le) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (service_name,le) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.description: Requests currently generating responses. Route and health filters do not apply. Connect null values: Threshold, 5 minutes; this affects line rendering only.

panels.title: Route & method comparison

Counts, average requests/s, HTTP 5xx fraction, and p50/p95/p99 all use the same range. panels.title: Database operation outcomes
panels.description: Repository/transaction operations, not individual SQL statements. Expected user-fault database errors are rejected; nested durations overlap.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name,operation,outcome) (rate(campusgo_database_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="supplier-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Database operation p95

panels.title: Application telemetry age
panels.description: Age of the application's exported Unix timestamp, not Prometheus's scrape timestamp. Stale at 45 seconds.
